lines: O Lord, who made the hills, and saw fit to set this one at an incline…
…look down upon this creature, who has borne so many of our brothers upward…
…and give her strength to bear one more, though he weighs, by every account, very little…
…and her mother before her, who was also a mule, and also of firm opinions…
…the amen will be along shortly. I am paid to the foot.
